core_obligations: The author constructs row-to-row rook-sum ideals and their orthogonal partners over an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring, proves free ideal/quotient bases by permutation-pattern straightening, and identifies exact left/right annihilators through the group-algebra pairing. Coefficient extraction in tensor representations then realizes these ideals as action kernels. The semisimple direct-sum/product part retains its additional n!-invertibility hypothesis. These ideal/basis/kernel descriptions are one structural object.
